items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: So I called up Petrillo and I explained to him what was going on, and he sent him a wire.

ctx.x: So finally he said, 'Well, tomorrow night you guys are going to play in the parking lot.' And I said, 'The parking lot?' So I called up Petrillo and I explained to him what was going on, and he sent him a wire. He said, 'Special scale for bands playing in the parking lot. Side man, $1,500.00 a week. Leader, $5,000.' Well, that was the end of that.
